artifacts.purpose: Explicit companion identity when Git configuration cannot establish convention-based discovery.
artifacts.producer: Operator initializing an already verified PRIVATE companion.

retention_rule.rule: Keep while convention-based consumers use this identity; the marker never replaces PRIVATE visibility or write-admission checks.

artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the verified companion revision or recreate the tool identity after checking the destination.

artifacts.purpose: Companion setup metadata linking to the source contract.
artifacts.schema: DATA.md and the source initializer, when present.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only the minimal current setup instructions and exclusions; replace obsolete copies.

artifacts.purpose: Inventory and secret references for an explicitly retained deployment.
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Config validation and any separately authorized recovery.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the reviewed inventory and revalidate every host before deployment.

retention_rule.rule: Keep only inventories needed for a current deployment or explicitly retained recovery. Local retirement does not authorize changing remote hosts.

artifacts.purpose: Minimal private OAuth recovery material for a retired local installation.
artifacts.schema: Environment KEY=VALUE credential format; skills/box-rclone-binder/CONFIG.md secret-reference rules.
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore from the approved private backup; token validity must be checked independently.

retention_rule.rule: Retain the selected recovery material after local retirement. Replace or remove it only when recovery is no longer required and credential rotation or revocation has been reconciled.
